t.en: There are a number of functions available for checking to see if the elements of a matrix meet some condition, and for rearranging the elements of a matrix. For example, Octave can easily tell you if all the elements of a matrix are finite, or are less than some specified value. Octave can also rotate the elements, extract the upper- or lower-triangular parts, or sort the columns of a matrix.
t.zh: Octave 提供了不少函数，用来检查矩阵的元素是否满足某个条件，也用来重新排列矩阵的元素。例如，Octave 可以很方便地告诉你一个矩阵的元素是否全部有限、是否都小于某个给定值；它还能旋转元素、提取上三角或下三角部分、对矩阵的各列排序。

t.en: Finding Elements and Checking Conditions
t.zh: 查找元素与检查条件

t.en: The functions `any` and `all` are useful for determining whether any or all of the elements of a matrix satisfy some condition. The `find` function is also useful in determining which elements of a matrix meet a specified condition.
t.zh: 函数 `any` 和 `all` 用来判断矩阵中是否有元素、或是否所有元素满足某个条件。函数 `find` 则用来找出矩阵中哪些元素满足给定条件。

t.en: For a vector argument, return true (logical 1) if any element of the vector is nonzero.
t.zh: 对向量参数，只要向量中有任何一个元素非零，就返回真（逻辑值 1）。

t.en: For a matrix argument, return a row vector of logical ones and zeros with each element indicating whether any of the elements of the corresponding column of the matrix are nonzero. For example:
t.zh: 对矩阵参数，返回一个由逻辑 1 和 0 组成的行向量，其中每个元素表示矩阵对应列中是否有元素非零。例如：

t.en: If the optional argument *dim* is supplied, work along dimension *dim*. For example:
t.zh: 如果给出了可选参数 *dim*，则沿维度 *dim* 进行判断。例如：

t.en: See also: `all`.
t.zh: 另见：`all`。

t.en: For a vector argument, return true (logical 1) if all elements of the vector are nonzero.
t.zh: 对向量参数，只有向量中所有元素都非零时，才返回真（逻辑值 1）。

t.en: For a matrix argument, return a row vector of logical ones and zeros with each element indicating whether all of the elements of the corresponding column of the matrix are nonzero. For example:
t.zh: 对矩阵参数，返回一个由逻辑 1 和 0 组成的行向量，其中每个元素表示矩阵对应列中的所有元素是否都非零。例如：

t.en: If the optional argument *dim* is supplied, work along dimension *dim*. See also: `any`.
t.zh: 如果给出了可选参数 *dim*，则沿维度 *dim* 进行判断。另见：`any`。

t.en: Since the comparison operators (see Comparison Ops) return matrices of ones and zeros, it is easy to test a matrix for many things, not just whether the elements are nonzero. For example,
t.zh: 比较运算符（见 Comparison Ops）返回由 1 和 0 组成的矩阵，因此除了判断元素是否非零，我们还能用它来检验矩阵的许多其他性质。例如，

t.en: tests a random 5 by 5 matrix to see if all of its elements are less than 0.9.
t.zh: 检验一个随机的 5 × 5 矩阵，看它的所有元素是否都小于 0.9。

t.en: Note that in conditional contexts (like the test clause of `if` and `while` statements) Octave treats the test as if you had typed `all (all (condition))`.
t.zh: 注意，在条件语境中（例如 `if` 和 `while` 语句的判断子句），Octave 会把判断条件当作你写的是 `all (all (condition))`。

t.en: If *x* is a vector of length $n$, `diff (x)` is the vector of first differences $x_2 - x_1, \ldots{}, x_n - x_{n-1}$.
t.zh: 如果 *x* 是长度为 $n$ 的向量，则 `diff (x)` 是一阶差分向量 $x_2 - x_1, \ldots{}, x_n - x_{n-1}$。

t.en: If *x* is a matrix, `diff (x)` is the matrix of column differences along the first non-singleton dimension.
t.zh: 如果 *x* 是矩阵，则 `diff (x)` 是沿第一个非单一维度（长度不为 1 的维度）计算的列差分矩阵。

t.en: The second argument is optional. If supplied, `diff (x, k)`, where *k* is a non-negative integer, returns the *k*-th differences. It is possible that *k* is larger than the first non-singleton dimension of the matrix. In this case, `diff` continues to take the differences along the next non-singleton dimension.
t.zh: 第二个参数是可选的。若给出，则 `diff (x, k)`（其中 *k* 为非负整数）返回 *k* 阶差分。*k* 有可能比矩阵第一个非单一维度的长度还大，这时 `diff` 会继续沿下一个非单一维度做差分。

t.en: The dimension along which to take the difference can be explicitly stated with the optional variable *dim*. In this case the *k*-th order differences are calculated along this dimension. In the case where *k* exceeds `size (x, dim)` an empty matrix is returned. See also: `sort`, `merge`.
t.zh: 计算差分所沿的维度可以用可选变量 *dim* 明确指定。此时，*k* 阶差分沿该维度计算。如果 *k* 超过 `size (x, dim)`，则返回空矩阵。另见：`sort`、`merge`。

t.en: Return a logical array which is true where the elements of *x* are infinite and false where they are not.
t.zh: 返回一个逻辑数组：*x* 中为无穷大的元素处为真，其余处为假。

t.en: For example:
t.zh: 例如：

t.en: See also: `isfinite`, `isnan`, `isna`.
t.zh: 另见：`isfinite`、`isnan`、`isna`。

t.en: Return a logical array which is true where the elements of *x* are NaN values and false where they are not.
t.zh: 返回一个逻辑数组：*x* 中为 NaN 的元素处为真，其余处为假。

t.en: NA values are also considered NaN values. For example:
t.zh: NA 值也被视为 NaN 值。例如：

t.en: See also: `isna`, `isinf`, `isfinite`.
t.zh: 另见：`isna`、`isinf`、`isfinite`。

t.en: Return a vector of indices of nonzero elements of a matrix, as a row if *x* is a row vector or as a column otherwise.
t.zh: 返回矩阵中非零元素的下标向量：若 *x* 是行向量，则结果为行向量，否则为列向量。

t.en: To obtain a single index for each matrix element, Octave pretends that the columns of a matrix form one long vector (like Fortran arrays are stored). For example:
t.zh: 为了给矩阵的每个元素只用一个下标，Octave 把矩阵的各列依次首尾相接，看作一个长向量（与 Fortran 数组的存储方式相同）。例如：

t.en: If two inputs are given, *n* indicates the maximum number of elements to find from the beginning of the matrix or vector.
t.zh: 如果给出两个输入，*n* 表示从矩阵或向量的开头起，最多查找多少个元素。

t.en: If three inputs are given, *direction* should be one of `"first"` or `"last"`, requesting only the first or last *n* indices, respectively. However, the indices are always returned in ascending order.
t.zh: 如果给出三个输入，*direction* 应为 `"first"` 或 `"last"` 之一，分别表示只要前 *n* 个或后 *n* 个下标。不过，返回的下标总是按升序排列。

t.en: If two outputs are requested, `find` returns the row and column indices of nonzero elements of a matrix. For example:
t.zh: 如果要求两个输出，`find` 返回矩阵中非零元素的行下标和列下标。例如：

t.en: If three outputs are requested, `find` also returns a vector containing the nonzero values. For example:
t.zh: 如果要求三个输出，`find` 还会返回一个包含这些非零值的向量。例如：

t.en: If *x* is a multi-dimensional array of size m x n x p x …, *j* contains the column locations as if *x* was flattened into a two-dimensional matrix of size m x (n + p + …).
t.zh: 如果 *x* 是大小为 m x n x p x … 的多维数组，则 *j* 给出的列位置，相当于把 *x* 展平成大小为 m x (n + p + …) 的二维矩阵后的列位置。

t.en: Note that this function is particularly useful for sparse matrices, as it extracts the nonzero elements as vectors, which can then be used to create the original matrix. For example:
t.zh: 注意，这个函数对稀疏矩阵特别有用：它把非零元素提取成向量，这些向量又可以用来重建原矩阵。例如：

t.en: See also: `nonzeros`.
t.zh: 另见：`nonzeros`。

t.en: If you wish to check if a variable exists at all, instead of properties its elements may have, consult Status of Variables.
t.zh: 如果你想检查某个变量是否存在，而不是检查它的元素具有什么性质，请参阅 Status of Variables。

t.en: Rearranging Matrices
t.zh: 重新排列矩阵

t.en: Flip array left to right.
t.zh: 把数组左右翻转。

t.en: Return a copy of *A* with the order of the columns reversed. In other words, *A* is flipped left-to-right about a vertical axis. For example:
t.zh: 返回 *A* 的一个副本，其各列的顺序被颠倒。换句话说，*A* 绕竖直轴做了左右翻转。例如：

t.en: See also: `flipud`, `flip`, `rot90`, `rotdim`.
t.zh: 另见：`flipud`、`flip`、`rot90`、`rotdim`。

t.en: Flip array upside down.
t.zh: 把数组上下翻转。

t.en: Return a copy of *A* with the order of the rows reversed. In other words, *A* is flipped upside-down about a horizontal axis. For example:
t.zh: 返回 *A* 的一个副本，其各行的顺序被颠倒。换句话说，*A* 绕水平轴做了上下翻转。例如：

t.en: See also: `fliplr`, `flip`, `rot90`, `rotdim`.
t.zh: 另见：`fliplr`、`flip`、`rot90`、`rotdim`。

t.en: Return a copy of array *A* flipped across dimension *dim*.
t.zh: 返回数组 *A* 沿维度 *dim* 翻转后的副本。

t.en: If *dim* is unspecified it defaults to the first non-singleton dimension.
t.zh: 如果未指定 *dim*，则默认取第一个非单一维度。

t.en: Examples:
t.zh: 例：

blocks.text:
## row vector
 flip ([1  2  3  4])
       ⇒  4  3  2  1

 ## column vector
 flip ([1; 2; 3; 4])
       ⇒  4
           3
           2
           1

 ## 2-D matrix along dimension 1
 flip ([1 2; 3 4])
       ⇒  3  4
           1  2

 ## 2-D matrix along dimension 2
 flip ([1 2; 3 4], 2)
       ⇒  2  1
           4  3

t.en: See also: `fliplr`, `flipud`, `rot90`, `rotdim`, `permute`, `transpose`.
t.zh: 另见：`fliplr`、`flipud`、`rot90`、`rotdim`、`permute`、`transpose`。

t.en: Rotate array by 90 degree increments.
t.zh: 按 90 度的整数倍旋转数组。

t.en: Return a copy of *A* with the elements rotated counterclockwise in 90-degree increments.
t.zh: 返回 *A* 的一个副本，其元素按逆时针方向、以 90 度为单位旋转。

t.en: The second argument is optional, and specifies how many 90-degree rotations are to be applied (the default value is 1). Negative values of *k* rotate the matrix in a clockwise direction. For example,
t.zh: 第二个参数是可选的，指定要旋转多少个 90 度（默认值为 1）。*k* 取负值时，矩阵按顺时针方向旋转。例如，

t.en: rotates the given matrix clockwise by 90 degrees. The following are all equivalent statements:
t.zh: 把给定的矩阵顺时针旋转 90 度。下面几条语句都是等价的：

t.en: The rotation is always performed on the plane of the first two dimensions, i.e., rows and columns. To perform a rotation on any other plane, use `rotdim`.
t.zh: 旋转总是在前两个维度（即行和列）所在的平面上进行。若要在其他平面上旋转，请使用 `rotdim`。

t.en: See also: `rotdim`, `fliplr`, `flipud`, `flip`.
t.zh: 另见：`rotdim`、`fliplr`、`flipud`、`flip`。

t.en: Return the concatenation of N-D array objects, *array1*, *array2*, …, *arrayN* along dimension *dim*.
t.zh: 返回 N 维数组对象 *array1*、*array2*、…、*arrayN* 沿维度 *dim* 拼接后的结果。

t.en: Alternatively, we can concatenate *A* and *B* along the second dimension in the following way:
t.zh: 或者，我们也可以用下面的方式沿第二个维度拼接 *A* 和 *B*：

t.en: *dim* can be larger than the dimensions of the N-D array objects and the result will thus have *dim* dimensions as the following example shows:
t.zh: *dim* 可以大于这些 N 维数组对象的维数，此时结果就有 *dim* 个维度，如下面的例子所示：

t.en: See also: `horzcat`, `vertcat`.
t.zh: 另见：`horzcat`、`vertcat`。

t.en: Return the horizontal concatenation of N-D array objects, *array1*, *array2*, …, *arrayN* along dimension 2.
t.zh: 返回 N 维数组对象 *array1*、*array2*、…、*arrayN* 沿维度 2 水平拼接后的结果。

t.en: Arrays may also be concatenated horizontally using the syntax for creating new matrices. For example:
t.zh: 数组也可以用创建新矩阵的语法进行水平拼接。例如：

t.en: This syntax is slightly more efficient because the Octave parser can concatenate the arrays without the overhead of a function call. See also: `cat`, `vertcat`.
t.zh: 这种语法的效率略高一些，因为 Octave 的解析器可以直接拼接数组，省去函数调用的开销。另见：`cat`、`vertcat`。

t.en: Return the vertical concatenation of N-D array objects, *array1*, *array2*, …, *arrayN* along dimension 1.
t.zh: 返回 N 维数组对象 *array1*、*array2*、…、*arrayN* 沿维度 1 垂直拼接后的结果。

t.en: Arrays may also be concatenated vertically using the syntax for creating new matrices. For example:
t.zh: 数组也可以用创建新矩阵的语法进行垂直拼接。例如：

t.en: This syntax is slightly more efficient because the Octave parser can concatenate the arrays without the overhead of a function call. See also: `cat`, `horzcat`.
t.zh: 这种语法的效率略高一些，因为 Octave 的解析器可以直接拼接数组，省去函数调用的开销。另见：`cat`、`horzcat`。

t.en: Return the generalized transpose for an N-D array object *A*.
t.zh: 返回 N 维数组对象 *A* 的广义转置。

t.en: The permutation vector *perm* must contain the elements `1:ndims (A)` (in any order, but each element must appear only once). The *N*th dimension of *A* gets remapped to dimension `PERM(N)`. For example:
t.zh: 排列向量 *perm* 必须包含 `1:ndims (A)` 中的所有元素（顺序任意，但每个元素只能出现一次）。*A* 的第 *N* 个维度被重新映射为维度 `PERM(N)`。例如：

blocks.text:
x = zeros ([2, 3, 5, 7]);
size (x)
   ⇒  2   3   5   7

size (permute (x, [2, 1, 3, 4]))
   ⇒  3   2   5   7

size (permute (x, [1, 3, 4, 2]))
   ⇒  2   5   7   3

## The identity permutation
size (permute (x, [1, 2, 3, 4]))
   ⇒  2   3   5   7

t.en: See also: `ipermute`.
t.zh: 另见：`ipermute`。

t.en: Return a matrix with the specified dimensions (*m*, *n*, …) whose elements are taken from the matrix *A*.
t.zh: 返回一个具有指定维度（*m*、*n*、…）的矩阵，其元素取自矩阵 *A*。

t.en: The elements of the matrix are accessed in column-major order (like Fortran arrays are stored).
t.zh: 矩阵的元素按列优先的顺序读取（与 Fortran 数组的存储方式相同）。

t.en: The following code demonstrates reshaping a 1x4 row vector into a 2x2 square matrix.
t.zh: 下面的代码演示如何把 1x4 的行向量重塑为 2x2 的方阵。

t.en: Note that the total number of elements in the original matrix (`prod (size (A))`) must match the total number of elements in the new matrix (`prod ([m n …])`).
t.zh: 注意，原矩阵的元素总数（`prod (size (A))`）必须等于新矩阵的元素总数（`prod ([m n …])`）。

t.en: A single dimension of the return matrix may be left unspecified and Octave will determine its size automatically. An empty matrix ([]) is used to flag the unspecified dimension. See also: `resize`, `vec`, `postpad`, `cat`, `squeeze`.
t.zh: 返回矩阵的某一个维度可以不指定，Octave 会自动确定它的大小。此时用空矩阵（[]）来标记那个未指定的维度。另见：`resize`、`vec`、`postpad`、`cat`、`squeeze`。

t.en: Circularly shift the values of the array *x*.
t.zh: 对数组 *x* 的值做循环移位。

t.en: *n* must be a vector of integers no longer than the number of dimensions in *x*. The values of *n* can be either positive or negative, which determines the direction in which the values of *x* are shifted. If an element of *n* is zero, then the corresponding dimension of *x* will not be shifted. If *n* is a scalar and no *dim* is specified then the shift is applied to the first non-singular dimension.
t.zh: *n* 必须是整数向量，其长度不超过 *x* 的维数。*n* 的值可正可负，决定了移位的方向。如果 *n* 的某个元素为零，则 *x* 对应的维度不移位。如果 *n* 是标量且没有指定 *dim*，则对第一个非单一维度做移位。

t.en: If a scalar *dim* is given then operate along the specified dimension. In this case *n* must be a scalar as well.
t.zh: 如果给出标量 *dim*，则沿指定的维度操作。此时 *n* 也必须是标量。

t.en: Examples:
t.zh: 例：

blocks.text:
x = [1, 2, 3;
      4, 5, 6;
      7, 8, 9];
 ## positive shift on rows (1st non-singular dim)
 circshift (x, 1)
   ⇒
        7   8   9
        1   2   3
        4   5   6
 ## negative shift on rows (1st non-singular dim)
 circshift (x, -2)
   ⇒
        7   8   9
        1   2   3
        4   5   6
 ## no shift of rows, shift columns by 1 (2nd dimension)
 circshift (x, [0,1])
   ⇒
        3   1   2
        6   4   5
        9   7   8
 ## shift columns (2nd dimension)
 circshift (x, 1, 2)
   ⇒
        3   1   2
        6   4   5
        9   7   8

t.en: See also: `permute`, `ipermute`, `shiftdim`.
t.zh: 另见：`permute`、`ipermute`、`shiftdim`。

t.en: Return a copy of *x* with the elements arranged in increasing order.
t.zh: 返回 *x* 的一个副本，其元素按递增顺序排列。

t.en: For matrices, `sort` orders the elements within columns
t.zh: 对矩阵，`sort` 在各列内部对元素排序。

t.en: For example:
t.zh: 例如：

t.en: If the optional argument *dim* is given, then the matrix is sorted along the dimension defined by *dim*. The optional argument *mode* defines the order in which the values will be sorted. Valid values of *mode* are `"ascend"` or `"descend"`.
t.zh: 如果给出可选参数 *dim*，则沿 *dim* 指定的维度排序。可选参数 *mode* 指定排序的顺序，有效值为 `"ascend"` 或 `"descend"`。

t.en: The `sort` function may also be used to produce a matrix containing the original row indices of the elements in the sorted matrix. For example:
t.zh: `sort` 函数还可以生成一个矩阵，其中包含排序后各元素在原矩阵中的行下标。例如：

t.en: For equal elements, the indices are such that equal elements are listed in the order in which they appeared in the original list.
t.zh: 对于相等的元素，下标的排列方式是：相等的元素按它们在原列表中出现的先后顺序列出。

t.en: Sorting of complex entries is done first by magnitude (`abs (z)`) and for any ties by phase angle (`angle (z)`). For example:
t.zh: 复数元素先按模（`abs (z)`）排序，模相同时再按辐角（`angle (z)`）排序。例如：

t.en: NaN values are treated as being greater than any other value and are sorted to the end of the list.
t.zh: NaN 值被视为大于任何其他值，排在列表末尾。

t.en: The `sort` function may also be used to sort strings and cell arrays of strings, in which case ASCII dictionary order (uppercase 'A' precedes lowercase 'a') of the strings is used.
t.zh: `sort` 函数也可以对字符串和字符串元胞数组排序，此时按字符串的 ASCII 字典序排列（大写字母 'A' 排在小写字母 'a' 之前）。

t.en: The algorithm used in `sort` is optimized for the sorting of partially ordered lists. See also: `sortrows`, `issorted`.
t.zh: `sort` 所用的算法针对部分有序的列表做了优化。另见：`sortrows`、`issorted`。

t.en: Return a new matrix formed by extracting the lower triangular part of the matrix *A*, and setting all other elements to zero.
t.zh: 返回一个新矩阵，它由矩阵 *A* 的下三角部分提取而成，其余元素置为零。

t.en: The optional second argument specifies how many diagonals above or below the main diagonal should also be set to zero. The default value of *k* is zero which includes the main diagonal as part of the result. If the value of *k* is a nonzero integer then the selection of elements starts at an offset of *k* diagonals above the main diagonal for positive *k* or below the main diagonal for negative *k*. The absolute value of *k* may not be greater than the number of subdiagonals or superdiagonals.
t.zh: 可选的第二个参数指定主对角线上方或下方的多少条对角线也要置零。*k* 的默认值为零，此时主对角线包含在结果中。如果 *k* 是非零整数，则从偏离主对角线 *k* 条对角线的位置开始选取元素：*k* 为正时在主对角线上方，*k* 为负时在主对角线下方。*k* 的绝对值不能超过次对角线或超对角线的条数。

t.en: Example 1 : exclude main diagonal
t.zh: 例 1：不含主对角线

t.en: Example 2 : include first superdiagonal
t.zh: 例 2：包含第一条超对角线

t.en: If the optional third argument `"pack"` is given then the extracted elements are not inserted into a matrix, but instead stacked column-wise one above another, and returned as a column vector. See also: `triu`, `istril`, `diag`.
t.zh: 如果给出可选的第三个参数 `"pack"`，则提取出的元素不会放回矩阵中，而是按列依次上下堆叠，作为列向量返回。另见：`triu`、`istril`、`diag`。

t.en: Return a new matrix formed by extracting the upper triangular part of the matrix *A*, and setting all other elements to zero.
t.zh: 返回一个新矩阵，它由矩阵 *A* 的上三角部分提取而成，其余元素置为零。

t.en: The optional second argument specifies how many diagonals above or below the main diagonal should also be set to zero. The default value of *k* is zero which includes the main diagonal as part of the result. If the value of *k* is a nonzero integer then the selection of elements starts at an offset of *k* diagonals above the main diagonal for positive *k* or below the main diagonal for negative *k*. The absolute value of *k* may not be greater than the number of subdiagonals or superdiagonals.
t.zh: 可选的第二个参数指定主对角线上方或下方的多少条对角线也要置零。*k* 的默认值为零，此时主对角线包含在结果中。如果 *k* 是非零整数，则从偏离主对角线 *k* 条对角线的位置开始选取元素：*k* 为正时在主对角线上方，*k* 为负时在主对角线下方。*k* 的绝对值不能超过次对角线或超对角线的条数。

t.zh: 如果给出可选的第三个参数 `"pack"`，则提取出的元素不会放回矩阵中，而是按列依次上下堆叠，作为列向量返回。另见：`tril`、`istriu`、`diag`。

t.zh: 如果给出 *dim*，则 *v* 的维度被设为 *dim*，所有元素都排在最后一个维度上。这等价于 `shiftdim (x(:), 1-dim)`。另见：`vech`、`resize`、`cat`。

t.zh: 返回一个对角矩阵，其第 *k* 条对角线上放置向量 *v*。

t.zh: 三个输入的形式返回一个对角矩阵，向量 *v* 放在主对角线上，结果矩阵的大小为 *m* 行 x *n* 列。

t.en: Given a matrix argument, instead of a vector, `diag` extracts the *k*-th diagonal of the matrix.
t.zh: 如果参数是矩阵而不是向量，`diag` 则提取该矩阵的第 *k* 条对角线。

t.en: All arguments must be numeric and either two-dimensional matrices or scalars. If any argument is of type sparse, the output will also be sparse. See also: `diag`, `horzcat`, `vertcat`, `sparse`.
t.zh: 所有参数都必须是数值型的二维矩阵或标量。只要有一个参数是稀疏类型，输出也是稀疏的。另见：`diag`、`horzcat`、`vertcat`、`sparse`。

t.en: Return a matrix or N-dimensional array whose elements are all 1.
t.zh: 返回元素全为 1 的矩阵或 N 维数组。

t.en: If invoked with a single scalar integer argument *n*, return a square
t.zh: 如果只用一个标量整数参数 *n* 调用，则返回一个方阵

t.en: If invoked with two or more scalar integer arguments, or a vector of integer values, return an array with the given dimensions.
t.zh: 如果用两个或更多个标量整数参数、或一个整数向量调用，则返回具有给定维度的数组。

t.zh: 如果在 `"like"` 之后指定了变量 *var*，则输出 *val* 与 *var* 具有相同的数据类型、复数性和稀疏性。

t.zh: 返回元素全为 0 的矩阵或 N 维数组。

t.en: If invoked with a single scalar integer argument, return a square
t.zh: 如果只用一个标量整数参数调用，则返回一个方阵

t.en: If invoked with two or more scalar integer arguments, or a vector of integer values, return an array with the given dimensions.
t.zh: 如果用两个或更多个标量整数参数、或一个整数向量调用，则返回具有给定维度的数组。

t.en: If a variable *var* is specified after `"like"`, the output *val* will have the same data type, complexity, and sparsity as *var*.
t.zh: 如果在 `"like"` 之后指定了变量 *var*，则输出 *val* 与 *var* 具有相同的数据类型、复数性和稀疏性。

t.en: The optional argument *class* specifies the class of the return array and defaults to double. For example:
t.zh: 可选参数 *class* 指定返回数组的类型，默认为 double。例如：

t.en: See also: `ones`.
t.zh: 另见：`ones`。

t.en: Repeat matrix or N-D array.
t.zh: 重复排列矩阵或 N 维数组。

t.en: Form a block matrix of size *m* by *n*, with a copy of matrix *A* as each element.
t.zh: 构造一个 *m* 行 *n* 列的分块矩阵，其每个元素（每一块）都是矩阵 *A* 的一份副本。

t.en: If *n* is not specified, form an *m* by *m* block matrix. For copying along more than two dimensions, specify the number of times to copy across each dimension *m*, *n*, *p*, …, in a vector in the second argument.
t.zh: 如果没有指定 *n*，则构造 *m* 行 *m* 列的分块矩阵。若要沿多于两个维度复制，请在第二个参数中用向量给出沿每个维度 *m*、*n*、*p*、… 的复制次数。

t.en: See also: `bsxfun`, `kron`, `repelems`.
t.zh: 另见：`bsxfun`、`kron`、`repelems`。

t.en: The functions `linspace` and `logspace` make it very easy to create vectors with evenly or logarithmically spaced elements. See Ranges.
t.zh: 函数 `linspace` 和 `logspace` 可以很方便地创建元素等间距或按对数等间距分布的向量。参见 Ranges。

t.en: Return a row vector with *n* linearly spaced elements between *start* and *end*.
t.zh: 返回一个行向量，含 *n* 个在 *start* 与 *end* 之间线性等间距分布的元素。

t.en: If the number of elements *n* is greater than one, then the endpoints *start* and *end* are always included in the range. If *start* is greater than *end*, the elements are stored in decreasing order. If the number of points *n* is not specified, a value of 100 is used.
t.zh: 如果元素个数 *n* 大于 1，则端点 *start* 和 *end* 总是包含在内。如果 *start* 大于 *end*，元素按递减顺序存放。如果没有指定点数 *n*，则取 100。

t.en: The `linspace` function returns a row vector when both *start* and *end* are scalars. If one, or both, inputs are vectors, then `linspace` transforms them to column vectors and returns a matrix where each row is an independent sequence between `start(row_n), end(row_n)`.
t.zh: 当 *start* 和 *end* 都是标量时，`linspace` 返回行向量。如果其中一个或两个输入是向量，`linspace` 会先把它们变成列向量，然后返回一个矩阵，其中每一行都是一条独立的序列，范围介于 `start(row_n), end(row_n)` 之间。

t.en: Programming Notes: For compatibility with MATLAB, return the second argument (*end*) when a single value (*n* = 1) is requested. If *n* is not an integer then `floor (n)` is used to round the number of elements. If *n* is zero or negative then an empty 1x0 matrix is returned. See also: `colon`, `logspace`.
t.zh: 编程注记：为了与 MATLAB 兼容，当只要求一个值（*n* = 1）时，返回第二个参数（*end*）。如果 *n* 不是整数，则用 `floor (n)` 取整来确定元素个数。如果 *n* 为零或负数，则返回 1x0 的空矩阵。另见：`colon`、`logspace`。

t.en: Return a row vector with *n* elements logarithmically spaced from $10^{a}$ to $10^{b}$.
t.zh: 返回一个行向量，含 *n* 个元素，从 $10^{a}$ 到 $10^{b}$ 按对数等间距分布。

t.en: If the number of elements *n* is unspecified it defaults to 50.
t.zh: 如果没有指定元素个数 *n*，默认为 50。

t.en: If *b* is equal to $\pi$, the points are between $10^{a}$ and $\pi$, *not* $10^{a}$ and $10^{\pi}$, which is useful in digital signal processing.
t.zh: 如果 *b* 等于 $\pi$，则各点位于 $10^{a}$ 与 $\pi$ 之间，*而不是*位于 $10^{a}$ 与 $10^{\pi}$ 之间，这在数字信号处理中很有用。

t.en: Programming Notes: For compatibility with MATLAB, return the right-hand side of the range ($10^{b}$) when a single value (*n* = 1) is requested. If *n* is not an integer then `floor (n)` is used to round the number of elements. If *n* is zero or negative then an empty 1x0 matrix is returned. See also: `linspace`.
t.zh: 编程注记：为了与 MATLAB 兼容，当只要求一个值（*n* = 1）时，返回区间的右端点（$10^{b}$）。如果 *n* 不是整数，则用 `floor (n)` 取整来确定元素个数。如果 *n* 为零或负数，则返回 1x0 的空矩阵。另见：`linspace`。

t.en: Return a matrix with random elements uniformly distributed on the interval (0, 1).
t.zh: 返回一个矩阵，其元素是在区间 (0, 1) 上均匀分布的随机数。

t.en: The arguments are handled the same as the arguments for `eye`.
t.zh: 参数的处理方式与 `eye` 的参数相同。

t.en: You can query the state of the random number generator using the form
t.zh: 你可以用如下形式查询随机数生成器的状态

t.en: This returns a column vector *v* of length 625. Later, you can restore the random number generator to the state *v* using the form
t.zh: 这会返回一个长度为 625 的列向量 *v*。之后，你可以用如下形式把随机数生成器恢复到状态 *v*

t.en: You may also initialize the state vector from an arbitrary vector of length 625 for *v*. This new state will be a hash based on the value of *v*, not *v* itself.
t.zh: 你也可以用任意一个长度为 625 的向量作为 *v* 来初始化状态向量。这个新状态是基于 *v* 的值计算出的散列值，而不是 *v* 本身。

t.en: By default, the generator is initialized by contributing entropy from the wall clock time, the CPU time, the current fraction of a second, the process ID and—if available—up to 1024 bits from the C++ random numbers source `random_device`, which might be non-deterministic (implementation specific). Note that this differs from MATLAB, which always initializes the state to the same state at startup. To obtain behavior comparable to MATLAB, initialize with a deterministic state vector in Octave's startup files (see Startup Files).
t.zh: 默认情况下，生成器的初始化会混入多种熵：挂钟时间、CPU 时间、当前时刻的秒的小数部分、进程 ID，以及（如果可用）来自 C++ 随机数源 `random_device` 的至多 1024 位——后者可能是非确定性的（取决于具体实现）。注意，这与 MATLAB 不同，MATLAB 每次启动时总是把状态初始化为同一个状态。若想得到与 MATLAB 类似的行为，请在 Octave 的启动文件中用确定的状态向量初始化（参见 Startup Files）。

t.en: To compute the pseudo-random sequence, `rand` uses the Mersenne Twister with a period of $2^{19937}-1$ (See M. Matsumoto and T. Nishimura, *Mersenne Twister: A 623-dimensionally equidistributed uniform pseudorandom number generator*, pp. 3--30, January 1998, http://www.math.sci.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/~m-mat/MT/emt.html). Do **not** use for cryptography without securely hashing several returned values together, otherwise the generator state can be learned after reading 624 consecutive values.
t.zh: `rand` 用周期为 $2^{19937}-1$ 的 Mersenne Twister 来计算伪随机序列（参见 M. Matsumoto 和 T. Nishimura 的 *Mersenne Twister: A 623-dimensionally equidistributed uniform pseudorandom number generator*，第 3--30 页，1998 年 1 月，http://www.math.sci.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/~m-mat/MT/emt.html）。**不要**把它用于密码学，除非先把若干个返回值一起做安全散列，否则读取 624 个连续值之后，就能推知生成器的状态。

t.en: Older versions of Octave used a different random number generator. The new generator is used by default as it is significantly faster than the old generator, and produces random numbers with a significantly longer cycle time. However, in some circumstances it might be desirable to obtain the same random sequences as produced by the old generators. To do this the keyword `"seed"` is used to specify that the old generators should be used, as in
t.zh: 旧版本的 Octave 使用另一种随机数生成器。新生成器默认启用，因为它比旧生成器快得多，产生的随机数周期也长得多。不过，在某些情况下，你可能希望得到与旧生成器相同的随机序列。为此，用关键字 `"seed"` 指定使用旧生成器，如

t.en: which sets the seed of the generator to *val*. The seed of the generator can be queried with
t.zh: 它把生成器的种子设为 *val*。可以用下面的形式查询生成器的种子

t.en: However, it should be noted that querying the seed will not cause `rand` to use the old generators, only setting the seed will. To cause `rand` to once again use the new generators, the keyword `"state"` should be used to reset the state of the `rand`.
t.zh: 不过要注意，查询种子并不会让 `rand` 改用旧生成器，只有设置种子才会。若要让 `rand` 重新使用新生成器，应当用关键字 `"state"` 来重置 `rand` 的状态。

t.en: The state or seed of the generator can be reset to a new random value using the `"reset"` keyword.
t.zh: 可以用关键字 `"reset"` 把生成器的状态或种子重置为一个新的随机值。

t.en: The class of the value returned can be controlled by a trailing `"double"` or `"single"` argument. These are the only valid classes. See also: `randn`, `rande`, `randg`, `randp`.
t.zh: 返回值的类型可以由末尾的 `"double"` 或 `"single"` 参数控制，只有这两种类型有效。另见：`randn`、`rande`、`randg`、`randp`。

t.en: Return random integers in the range 1:*imax*.
t.zh: 返回区间 1:*imax* 内的随机整数。

t.en: Additional arguments determine the shape of the return matrix. When no arguments are specified a single random integer is returned. If one argument *n* is specified then a square matrix (*n* x *n*) is returned. Two or more arguments will return a multi-dimensional matrix (*m* x *n* x …).
t.zh: 其余参数决定返回矩阵的形状。不给参数时，返回单个随机整数。如果给出一个参数 *n*，则返回方阵（*n* x *n*）。给出两个或更多参数时，返回多维矩阵（*m* x *n* x …）。

t.en: The integer range may optionally be described by a two-element matrix with a lower and upper bound in which case the returned integers will be on the interval [*imin*, *imax*].
t.zh: 整数范围也可以用一个含上下界的两元素矩阵来描述，此时返回的整数落在区间 [*imin*, *imax*] 内。

t.en: The optional argument *class* will return a matrix of the requested type. The default is `"double"`.
t.zh: 可选参数 *class* 使函数返回指定类型的矩阵，默认为 `"double"`。

t.en: The following example returns 150 integers in the range 1--10.
t.zh: 下面的例子返回 150 个范围在 1--10 之间的整数。

t.en: Implementation Note: `randi` relies internally on `rand` which uses class `"double"` to represent numbers. This limits the maximum integer (*imax*) and range (*imax* - *imin*) to the value returned by the `flintmax` function. For IEEE floating point numbers this value is $2^{53} - 1$.
t.zh: 实现说明：`randi` 内部依赖 `rand`，而它用类型 `"double"` 表示数值。这就把最大整数（*imax*）和范围（*imax* - *imin*）限制在 `flintmax` 函数返回的值以内。对于 IEEE 浮点数，这个值是 $2^{53} - 1$。

t.en: See also: `rand`, `randn`.
t.zh: 另见：`rand`、`randn`。

t.en: Return a matrix with normally distributed random elements having zero mean and variance one.
t.zh: 返回一个矩阵，其元素是均值为零、方差为一的正态分布随机数。

t.en: The arguments are handled the same as the arguments for `rand`.
t.zh: 参数的处理方式与 `rand` 的参数相同。

t.en: By default, `randn` uses the Marsaglia and Tsang “Ziggurat technique” to transform from a uniform to a normal distribution.
t.zh: 默认情况下，`randn` 使用 Marsaglia 和 Tsang 的“Ziggurat 方法”，把均匀分布变换为正态分布。

t.en: The class of the value returned can be controlled by a trailing `"double"` or `"single"` argument. These are the only valid classes.
t.zh: 返回值的类型可以由末尾的 `"double"` 或 `"single"` 参数控制，只有这两种类型有效。

t.en: Reference: G. Marsaglia and W.W. Tsang, *Ziggurat Method for Generating Random Variables*, J. Statistical Software, vol 5, 2000, https://www.jstatsoft.org/v05/i08/
t.zh: 参考文献：G. Marsaglia 和 W.W. Tsang，*Ziggurat Method for Generating Random Variables*，J. Statistical Software，第 5 卷，2000 年，https://www.jstatsoft.org/v05/i08/

t.en: See also: `rand`, `rande`, `randg`, `randp`.
t.zh: 另见：`rand`、`rande`、`randg`、`randp`。

t.en: The generators operate in the new or old style together, it is not possible to mix the two. Initializing any generator with `"state"` or `"seed"` causes the others to switch to the same style for future calls.
t.zh: 这些生成器要么都按新方式工作，要么都按旧方式工作，二者不能混用。用 `"state"` 或 `"seed"` 初始化任何一个生成器，都会使其余生成器在以后的调用中切换到同一种方式。

t.en: The state of each generator is independent and calls to different generators can be interleaved without affecting the final result. For example,
t.zh: 每个生成器的状态是相互独立的，对不同生成器的调用可以交错进行，而不影响最终结果。例如，

t.en: and
t.zh: 与

t.en: produce equivalent results. When the generators are initialized in the old style with `"seed"` only `rand` and `randn` are independent, because the old `rande`, `randg` and `randp` generators make calls to `rand` and `randn`.
t.zh: 产生等价的结果。当生成器用 `"seed"` 以旧方式初始化时，只有 `rand` 和 `randn` 是相互独立的，因为旧的 `rande`、`randg` 和 `randp` 生成器会调用 `rand` 和 `randn`。

t.en: The generators are initialized with random states at start-up, so that the sequences of random numbers are not the same each time you run Octave. (The old versions of `rand` and `randn` obtain their initial seeds from the system clock.) If you really do need to reproduce a sequence of numbers exactly, you can set the state or seed to a specific value.
t.zh: 这些生成器在启动时用随机的状态初始化，因此每次运行 Octave 得到的随机数序列并不相同。（旧版本的 `rand` 和 `randn` 从系统时钟获取初始种子。）如果你确实需要精确重现某个数列，可以把状态或种子设为特定的值。

t.en: If invoked without arguments, `rand` and `randn` return a single element of a random sequence.
t.zh: 如果不带参数调用，`rand` 和 `randn` 返回随机序列中的单个元素。

t.en: The original `rand` and `randn` functions use Fortran code from RANLIB, a library of Fortran routines for random number generation, compiled by Barry W. Brown and James Lovato of the Department of Biomathematics at The University of Texas, M.D. Anderson Cancer Center, Houston, TX 77030.
t.zh: 最初的 `rand` 和 `randn` 函数使用 RANLIB 的 Fortran 代码。RANLIB 是一个随机数生成的 Fortran 例程库，由美国得克萨斯州休斯敦市（TX 77030）得克萨斯大学 M.D. Anderson 癌症中心生物数学系的 Barry W. Brown 和 James Lovato 编制。

t.zh: 著名矩阵

t.zh: 下列函数返回一些著名的矩阵。

t.zh: 返回 *n* 阶 Hilbert 矩阵。

t.en: Hilbert matrices are close to being singular which make them difficult to invert with numerical routines. Comparing the condition number of a random matrix 5x5 matrix with that of a Hilbert matrix of order 5 reveals just how difficult the problem is.
t.zh: Hilbert 矩阵接近奇异，用数值方法对它求逆很困难。把一个 5x5 随机矩阵的条件数与 5 阶 Hilbert 矩阵的条件数比较一下，就能看出这个问题有多困难。

t.en: See also: `invhilb`.
t.zh: 另见：`invhilb`。

t.en: Create an *n*-by-*n* magic square.
t.zh: 创建一个 *n* 阶幻方（*n* 行 *n* 列）。

t.en: A magic square is an arrangement of the integers `1:n^2` such that the row sums, column sums, and diagonal sums are all equal to the same value.
t.zh: 幻方是整数 `1:n^2` 的一种排列，使得每一行的和、每一列的和以及两条对角线的和全都相等。

t.en: Note: *n* must be a scalar greater than or equal to 3. If you supply *n* less than 3, magic returns either a nonmagic square, or else the degenerate magic squares 1 and [].
t.zh: 注意：*n* 必须是不小于 3 的标量。如果 *n* 小于 3，magic 返回的要么不是幻方，要么是退化的幻方 1 和 []。

t.en: Return the Pascal matrix of order *n* if `t = 0`.
t.zh: 当 `t = 0` 时，返回 *n* 阶 Pascal 矩阵。

t.en: The default value of *t* is 0.
t.zh: *t* 的默认值为 0。

t.en: When `t = 1`, return the pseudo-lower triangular Cholesky factor of the Pascal matrix (The sign of some columns may be negative). This matrix is its own inverse, that is `pascal (n, 1) ^ 2 == eye (n)`.
t.zh: 当 `t = 1` 时，返回 Pascal 矩阵的伪下三角 Cholesky 因子（某些列的符号可能为负）。这个矩阵的逆就是它自己，即 `pascal (n, 1) ^ 2 == eye (n)`。

t.en: If `t = -1`, return the true Cholesky factor with strictly positive values on the diagonal.
t.zh: 如果 `t = -1`，返回真正的 Cholesky 因子，其对角线元素严格为正。

t.en: If `t = 2`, return a transposed and permuted version of `pascal (n, 1)`, which is the cube root of the identity matrix. That is, `pascal (n, 2) ^ 3 == eye (n)`.
t.zh: 如果 `t = 2`，返回 `pascal (n, 1)` 的转置并置换后的版本，它是单位矩阵的立方根。也就是 `pascal (n, 2) ^ 3 == eye (n)`。

t.en: See also: `chol`.
t.zh: 另见：`chol`。

t.en: Return the Toeplitz matrix constructed from the first column *c*, and optionally the first row *r*.
t.zh: 返回由第一列 *c*（以及可选的第一行 *r*）构造的 Toeplitz 矩阵。

t.en: If the second argument is omitted, the first row is taken to be the same as the first column. If the first element of *r* is not the same as the first element of *c*, the first element of *c* is used.
t.zh: 如果省略第二个参数，则第一行取得与第一列相同。如果 *r* 的第一个元素与 *c* 的第一个元素不同，则使用 *c* 的第一个元素。

t.en: A Toeplitz, or diagonal-constant, matrix has the same value along each diagonal. Although it need not be square, it often is. An MxN Toeplitz matrix has the form:
t.zh: Toeplitz 矩阵（也叫对角常数矩阵）沿每条对角线的元素值都相同。它不一定是方阵，但常常是方阵。一个 MxN 的 Toeplitz 矩阵形如：

blocks.tex: \left[\begin{matrix}c_1 & r_2 & r_3 & \cdots & r_n\\ c_2 & c_1 & r_2 & \cdots & r_{n-1}\\ c_3 & c_2 & c_1 & \cdots & r_{n-2}\\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots\\ c_m & c_{m-1} & c_{m-2} & \ldots & c{m-n+1}\end{matrix}\right]

t.en: See also: `hankel`.
t.zh: 另见：`hankel`。

t.en: Return the Vandermonde matrix whose next to last column is *c*.
t.zh: 返回 Vandermonde 矩阵，其倒数第二列是 *c*。

t.en: If *n* is specified, it determines the number of columns; otherwise, *n* is taken to be equal to the length of *c*.
t.zh: 如果指定了 *n*，它决定矩阵的列数；否则，*n* 取为 *c* 的长度。

t.en: A Vandermonde matrix has the form:
t.zh: Vandermonde 矩阵形如：

blocks.tex: \left[\begin{matrix}c_1^{n-1} & \cdots & c_1^2 & c_1 & 1 \\ c_2^{n-1} & \cdots & c_2^2 & c_2 & 1 \\ \vdots & \ddots & \vdots & \vdots & \vdots \\ c_n^{n-1} & \cdots & c_n^2 & c_n & 1\end{matrix}\right]

t.en: See also: `polyfit`.
t.zh: 另见：`polyfit`。
